description: This file defines the BiometricAuthManager class responsible for handling biometric authentication using LocalAuthentication framework. It provides an asynchronous method to authenticate the user with biometrics or fallback to device passcode, and throws custom errors upon failure.

classes.name: BiometricAuthManager
classes.description: Singleton class managing biometric authentication logic, providing an async method to authenticate the user with biometrics, with fallback handling and error throwing.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Asynchronously performs biometric or passcode authentication, throwing errors if unavailable or failed.
